items.label: Certified Safe Fabric
items.value: This queen size comforter set is certified by OEKO-TEX Standard 100, ensuring it meets high safety standards and is free from harmful substances; made from soft 100% microfiber, the interior is filled with premium 240 GSM 100% Polyester, providing a cloud-like sleeping experience suitable for all seasons

items.label: Anti-Wrinkle Textured Design
items.value: Unlike traditional, plain duvet covers, our slightly pleated seersucker texture is both beautiful and delicate; creates a vivid three-dimensional wavy pattern; the striped texture enhances this design, which is wrinkle-resistant and easy to care for; the gentle seersucker queen bedding set adds a unique sense of romance and elegance to your room

items.label: Deep Pocket Fitted Sheet
items.value: Our stretchy deep-pocket fitted sheet easily fits any 12-15 inch mattress and stays in place no matter how you toss and turn; the soft brushed microfiber fabric provides just the right amount of warmth and comfort

items.label: What's Included
items.value: The queen size bed set includes 1 Comforter (88" x 88"), 2 Pillowcases (20" x 30"), 2 Pillow Shams (20" x 26" + 2"), 1 Fitted Sheet (60" x 80" + 14"), and 1 Flat Sheet (90" x 102"); the set is packed in a vacuum bag; simply dry on low heat or gently fluff under the sun to restore its loft

items.label: Easy Care
items.value: Our bed in a bag set is easy to care for; simply machine wash in cold water; if you have any questions or concerns, our customer service team is here to help

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Seersucker Pillowshams & Standard Pillowcases, Comforter, Fitted Sheet, Flat Sheet

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Machine Wash in Cold Water, Tumble Dry Low
